div.head: Ger 12
div.ab: On længene eregian . 7 impian . beana sawan . wingeard settan . dician . deorhe|ge heawan . 7 raðe æfter ðam gif hit mot gewiderian . mederan settan . linsed sawan . wadsæd eac swa . wyrtun plantian . 7 fela ðin|ga . ic eal getellan ne mæig þæt god scirman bycgan sceal.

During spring to plough and to busy oneself with sowing beans, setting the vineyard, making dykes, cutting the animal hedge, and soon after that if the weather may be fair to set madder, sow linseed, sow woad and likewise to plant the garden and [do] many things. I cannot recount all [the things] that a good shireman must do.

[12] on længtene eregian 7 impian, beana sawan, wingeard settan, dician, deorhege heawan 7 raðe æfter ðam, gif hit mot gewiderian, mederan settan, linsed sawan, wadsæd eac swa, wyrtun plantian 7 fela ðinga'; ic eal geteallan ne mæig, þæt god scirman bycgan sceal.
